speechText: Here's today's one idea: cubing a number. A cube is just a value multiplied by itself twice more, value, times value, times value. Let's build it in Go. Sketch it first. Square multiplies a value by itself once; cube adds one more multiplication. Same shape, one extra step. Now the code. Square lives in its own file, and any file in the package can call it. Add cube right beside it, multiplying value three times. Now call cube from main, and print the result. Run it. If the Playground hiccups, the studio retries once, quietly. And there it is at the end: three cubed is twenty seven.
